verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.53
6. Overflowing Merit
Living Together (1st)

verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā antarā ca madhuraṁ antarā ca verañjaṁ addhānamaggappaṭipanno hoti.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was traveling along the road between Madhurā and Verañjā,

verses.pali: Sambahulāpi kho gahapatī ca gahapatāniyo ca antarā ca madhuraṁ antarā ca verañjaṁ addhānamaggappaṭipannā honti.
verses.english: as were several householders, both women and men.

verses.pali: Atha kho bhagavā maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṁ rukkhamūle (…) nisīdi.
verses.english: The Buddha left the road and sat at the root of a tree,

verses.pali: Addasaṁsu kho gahapatī ca gahapatāniyo ca bhagavantaṁ aññatarasmiṁ rukkhamūle nisinnaṁ.
verses.english: where the householders saw him.

verses.pali: Disvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṁsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdiṁsu. Ekamantaṁ nisinne kho te gahapatī ca gahapatāniyo ca bhagavā etadavoca:
verses.english: They went up to the Buddha, bowed, and sat down to one side. The Buddha said to them:
“Householders, there are four ways of living together.
What four?
A male zombie living with a female zombie;
a male zombie living with a goddess;
a god living with a female zombie;
a god living with a goddess.

verses.pali: Kathañca, gahapatayo, chavo chavāya saddhiṁ saṁvasati?
verses.english: And how does a male zombie live with a female zombie?

verses.pali: Idha, gahapatayo, sāmiko hoti pāṇātipātī adinnādāyī kāmesumicchācārī musāvādī surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī dussīlo pāpadhammo maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṁ ajjhāvasati akkosakaparibhāsako samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṁ;
verses.english: It’s when the husband kills living creatures, steals, commits sexual misconduct, lies, and consumes beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants. He’s unethical, of bad character, living at home with his heart full of the stain of stinginess, abusing and insulting ascetics and brahmins.

verses.pali: bhariyāpissa hoti pāṇātipātinī adinnādāyinī kāmesumicchācārinī musāvādinī surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyinī dussīlā pāpadhammā maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṁ ajjhāvasati akkosikaparibhāsikā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṁ.
verses.english: And the wife is also … unethical, of bad character …

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, gahapatayo, chavo chavāya saddhiṁ saṁvasati.
verses.english: That’s how a male zombie lives with a female zombie.

verses.pali: Kathañca, gahapatayo, chavo deviyā saddhiṁ saṁvasati?
verses.english: And how does a male zombie live with a goddess?

verses.pali: Idha, gahapatayo, sāmiko hoti pāṇātipātī adinnādāyī kāmesumicchācārī musāvādī surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī dussīlo pāpadhammo maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṁ ajjhāvasati akkosakaparibhāsako samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṁ;
verses.english: It’s when the husband … is unethical, of bad character …

verses.pali: bhariyā khvassa hoti pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā adinnādānā paṭiviratā kāmesumicchācārā paṭiviratā musāvādā paṭiviratā surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā sīlavatī kalyāṇadhammā vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṁ ajjhāvasati anakkosikaparibhāsikā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṁ.
verses.english: But the wife doesn’t kill living creatures, steal, commit sexual misconduct, lie, or consume beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants. She’s ethical, of good character, living at home with her heart rid of the stain of stinginess, not abusing and insulting ascetics and brahmins.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, gahapatayo, chavo deviyā saddhiṁ saṁvasati.
verses.english: That’s how a male zombie lives with a goddess.

verses.pali: Kathañca, gahapatayo, devo chavāya saddhiṁ saṁvasati?
verses.english: And how does a god live with a female zombie?

verses.pali: Idha, gahapatayo, sāmiko hoti pāṇātipātā paṭivirato adinnādānā paṭivirato kāmesumicchācārā paṭivirato musāvādā paṭivirato surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṁ ajjhāvasati anakkosakaparibhāsako samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṁ;
verses.english: It’s when the husband … is ethical, of good character …

verses.pali: bhariyā khvassa hoti pāṇātipātinī …pe… surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyinī dussīlā pāpadhammā maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṁ ajjhāvasati akkosikaparibhāsikā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṁ.
verses.english: But the wife … is unethical, of bad character …

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, gahapatayo, devo chavāya saddhiṁ saṁvasati.
verses.english: That’s how a god lives with a female zombie.

verses.pali: Kathañca, gahapatayo, devo deviyā saddhiṁ saṁvasati?
verses.english: And how does a god live with a goddess?

verses.pali: Idha, gahapatayo, sāmiko hoti pāṇātipātā paṭivirato …pe… sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṁ ajjhāvasati anakkosakaparibhāsako samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṁ;
verses.english: It’s when the husband … is ethical, of good character …

verses.pali: bhariyāpissa hoti pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā …pe… surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratā sīlavatī kalyāṇadhammā vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṁ ajjhāvasati anakkosikaparibhāsikā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṁ.
verses.english: And the wife is also … ethical, of good character …

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, gahapatayo, devo deviyā saddhiṁ saṁvasati.
verses.english: That’s how a god lives with a goddess.
These are the four ways of living together.
When both are unethical,
miserly and abusive,
then wife and husband
live together as zombies.
When the husband is unethical,
miserly and abusive,
but the wife is ethical,
bountiful, rid of stinginess,
she’s a goddess living
with a zombie for a husband.
When the husband is ethical,
bountiful, rid of stinginess,
but the wife is unethical,
miserly and abusive,
she’s a zombie living
with a god for a husband.
When both are faithful and bountiful,
disciplined, living righteously,
then wife and husband
say nice things to each other.
Their needs are amply satisfied,
so they live at ease.
Their enemies are downhearted,
when both are equal in ethics.
Having practiced the teaching here,
both equal in precepts and observances,
they delight in the heavenly realm,
enjoying all the pleasures they desire.”
